offering_description.value: Global real estate investment company that owns, operates and invests in multifamily, office, industrial and other properties, mainly in the US, UK, Ireland and Europe. It invests on its own balance sheet and through co-investment partnerships, earning management fees from third-party capital, and also provides real estate loans and services.

primary_services.value: investment management; property management; property services; real estate lending; real estate development

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors and co-investment partners, commercial tenants, borrowers; B2C: residential renters in multifamily apartments

end_markets.value: multifamily residential; commercial office; industrial and logistics; real estate investment management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment management fees and promotes from co-investment partners and funds; rental or leasing: rents from owned multifamily and commercial properties; interest or premiums: interest income on real estate loans; product sales: gains from sales of real estate and development
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; rental or leasing; interest or premiums; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates apartments and commercial properties, leasing to tenants; financial intermediary: raises and manages third-party capital and originates real estate loans for investors and borrowers

geography_served.value: global: United States (incl. Western US, Sunbelt), UK, Ireland, Spain and other Europe

specialization.value: related lines: real estate ownership, investment management, lending and development across property types

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house leasing and asset teams, capital raised directly from institutional partners; own locations: company-owned apartment communities and commercial buildings

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: real estate, securities and investment adviser rules, landlord-tenant and zoning laws, rent regulation, plus REIT-like tax and lending rules

notes: Recent portfolio mix and any asset sales or take-private status may have changed; details from general knowledge.
